definition: A comparison of amounts of the same kind, written $a : b$, meaning there are $a$ of the first for every $b$ of the second.
Two ratios that are equal, such as $2 : 3 = 8 : 12$; working in proportion means changing every amount by the same multiplier.
Two quantities are in direct proportion when multiplying one by a number multiplies the other by the same number, so their ratio stays the same.
A ratio $1 : n$ that links map and real distances: $1$ cm on the map stands for $n$ cm in real life.
